study.question: Does the observed reassignment penalty depend on the inherited half-cycle donor rule, when the donor scale multiset, forward model and parameter capacity are held fixed? Seed-42 history/action half reassignment AUCs are 0.6147298332575719/0.6147849008671875 versus full 0.6149816911798147. Action restriction did not rescue the full reference and worsened Logloss relative to history reassignment. History mean 0.6149872680212398 and fixed 0.6149888455418249 challenge necessity of exact eventwise scaling, while action mean 0.614672318575737 shows not every averaging rule works. The half-cycle rule may itself induce harmful scale/time/direction correlations. The intended six-arm seeds-43/44 study cannot be executed through this phase: seed 42 is frozen. Prepare only two bounded donor-distance replacements instead; explicitly defer robustness conclusions.
study.hypothesis: Conditional on observed adjacent donors actually having smaller elapsed-time and scale gaps, a one-eligible-position rotation may preserve more of the original scale/direction association than a half-cycle rotation and reduce its validation AUC penalty. This predicts sensitivity to reassignment structure, not beneficial semantic adaptivity or necessity of exact own scales. No direction is asserted for the action-by-distance interaction; optimizer conditioning, field sharing and seed effects remain alternative explanations.

study.proposed_difference: Two standalone modules with identical Model bodies and distinct literal CONFIG defaults: history_adjacent_tangent and action_adjacent_tangent. Both return u exactly at finite fixed states and alter only the detached backward donor scale in the existing aligned product channel. Whole-history and within-action variants retain inherited half modes for diagnostics/source checks. Existing matched half trials are reused rather than rerun at the same deterministic seed. This is a mechanism-discriminating replacement control, not a new architecture, performance result or novelty claim. Selection remains full-population host validation ROC-AUC; no training, assessment, installation or seed override is launched in this workspace. Reproduce local syntax checks without importing Torch: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; [compile(Path(p).read_text(), p, 'exec') for p in ('candidate.py', 'candidate_action_adjacent.py')]" from /workspace. predictions: For n>=4, adjacent can differ from half; for n<=3 they must agree. Every selected group preserves its scale multiset, sum and squared sum; inactive/unknown-action events retain own scales. The synthetic audit covers holes, empty/singleton groups, n>=4 same-action groups, floor, exact boundary and unknown helper action codes. Source identity alone does not certify autograd.

Synthetic host float64 product VJP scaled error should be <=1e-9 in all eight modes; same-state product/logit differences should be zero for finite tensors; first-512 float32 group sum/squared-sum relative errors should be <=1e-5. These are implementation checks with unknown outcomes at submission, not performance or mediation evidence.

Conditional locality prediction: adjacent minus half AUC >0 in each grouping, accompanied by smaller first-512 donor-age and own/donor scale gaps; Logloss is separately reported and need not move with AUC. Candidate-authored diagnostic associations cannot establish the mechanism even if this joint pattern appears.

Predeclare signed per-arm AUC/Logloss deltas against half, full and fixed, plus the grouping-by-distance difference in differences. Report parameters, host wall/train/peak memory and inference metrics. Existing references have 17130275 parameters; new constructors are unchanged. Same capacity/recipe does not establish equal compute or efficiency.

Use unchanged host slices (hour/history/action presence/frequency/missingness where exported), retaining samples/positives/negatives and marking unavailable or insufficient groups. Slices are exploratory; no post hoc rebinning, significance or selection by favorable slices. Paired user-cluster intervals require authorized predictions/identities, currently unavailable.
falsifiers: If either adjacent-minus-half AUC is nonpositive, the directional rescue prediction fails in that grouping. Opposite effects across groupings defeat a general rescue claim; do not select only a favorable arm.

If donor-age and scale gaps do not decrease, the proposed local-association implementation prediction is not observed. A gain without that pattern supports rule sensitivity only and leaves the locality explanation unsupported.

Nonzero finite forward differences, missing parameter/source agreement, synthetic VJP error >1e-9, float32 group conservation error >1e-5 or failed/missing diagnostics block implementation-based attribution. Missing counts or n>=4 activity limit interpretability; record execution failure separately from negative performance.

Later paired-seed reversals or nonpositive mean adjacent-minus-half AUC weaken robustness; deterministic seed-42 replay does not count. This proposal cannot establish robust superiority, calibrated probabilities, semantic relevance or a causal optimizer mechanism.
